name: IOICORP
recent: IOI Corporation Berhad 近期公告主要涉及大股东 EPF 的持续持股变动、董事 Dato' Lee Yeow Chor 在闭市期内的场内增持，以及董事会人事变动：Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 辞去非执行董事职务，Dato' Yeo How 重新加入担任独立非执行董事。公司于 11 月 4 日召开第 57 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过；同时公布了 10 月鲜果串产量数据。
notable: Dato' Lee Yeow Chor 于 2026 年 11 月 18 日通过公开市场增持 1,100,000 股普通股。
Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 辞去非执行董事职务，Dato' Yeo How 获委任为独立非执行董事。
公司公布 2026 年 10 月鲜果串自有产量为 328,329 公吨。
risks: 大股东 EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
董事 Dato' Lee Yeow Chor 在闭市期内进行场内交易。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 3,041,700,000，环比增长 13.7%，同比增长 2.8%；净利为 MYR 500,800,000，环比增长 76.8%，同比增长 14.7%；净利率为 16.5%，高于上一季度的 10.6%。

recent_en: IOI Corporation Berhad's recent announcements mainly involve continued shareholding changes by major shareholder EPF, on-market acquisitions by Director Dato' Lee Yeow Chor during the closed period, and board changes: Dato' Lee Yeow Seng resigned as non-executive director while Dato' Yeo How rejoined as independent non-executive director. The company held its 57th AGM on 4 November with all ordinary resolutions passed, and released October fresh fruit bunch production figures.
notable_en: Dato' Lee Yeow Chor acquired 1,100,000 ordinary shares through the open market on 18 November 2026.
Dato' Lee Yeow Seng resigned as non-executive director and Dato' Yeo How was appointed as independent non-executive director.
The company reported October 2026 own fresh fruit bunch production of 328,329 tonnes.
risks_en: Major shareholder EPF filed multiple shareholding changes between October and November.
Director Dato' Lee Yeow Chor traded on-market during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 3,041,700,000, up 13.7% QoQ and 2.8% YoY; net income was MYR 500,800,000, up 76.8% QoQ and 14.7% YoY; net margin was 16.5%, higher than 10.6% in the previous quarter.
